Author: lavaskin
Name: Mentor Roulette Tracker
Description: Keeps track of your Mentor Roulette runs and logs them to your account on Mentor Roulette Tracker (mentor.lavask.in).
Punchline: Logs your Mentor Roulette runs to Mentor Roulette Tracker.
Changelog:
### Added

- Settings can delete your uploaded runs, or all your runs, from the plugin, without touching the site (#19).

### Changed

- Minor tweaks (#19, #21).

### Fixed

- A run you turned the plugin off during is no longer logged as not cleared, and a chat line says when one isn't logged (#16).
